jobs.title: Principal Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

The Role

This is a 0→1 build. You'll own the architecture, build and rollout of Neko's internal AI developer platform, shaping how our engineers design, ship and operate software through agentic, AI-assisted workflows.

It's a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll be the person setting long-term direction for AI agents, tooling and the systems underneath them, while also doing the work. The expectation is that what you build gets used across teams and meaningfully changes how engineering happens here.

What You'll Deliver

In the first 6 months

A clear architectural direction for the platform
Initial components shipped and adopted by early teams
Measurable improvements to developer speed, reliability and autonomy
Genuine organic adoption across engineering, driven by value not mandate

By month 12

A substantive shift toward agentic, engineer-led development workflows
Platform scaled beyond pilot groups to multiple teams
Clear ownership models for agents, tooling and supporting systems
Long-term architecture defined and moving toward maturity

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

Proven experience building and shipping an internal developer platform, hands-on, not advisory
A strong track record leading agentic or AI-assisted development work that engineers actually use day-to-day
Real backend engineering depth with production systems, recent Java or C# strongly preferred
Experience rolling out platform tooling to 20-30+ developers with meaningful adoption
Expertise with workflow engines such as AWS Step Functions, Azure Durable Functions, Temporal, Conductor or Dagster
The ability to drive change through influence and credibility, not positional authority
10-15+ years of engineering experience with substantial platform ownership

Nice to have

Full-stack exposure, though backend depth is the priority
Background in product-led SaaS or organisations with strong internal developer tooling culture

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Hospitals and Health Care

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Integration Platform
jobs.description:
Do you want to shape how development teams across Sandvik build and operate integrations at scale? Join us in creating the platform capabilities, automation and templates that enable secure self-service delivery across the organization.

Some of the things you'll do:

Build reusable capabilities that reduce manual work and enable independence.
Influence the developer experience across APIs, integrations and event-driven solutions.
Collaborate closely with architects, product specialists, and development teams.

Your mission

In this position, you focus on building the tools, templates, and automation that enable development teams to create and operate integrations independently. Experience with end-to-end integration delivery is great to have, although this work centers on reusable platform capabilities rather than individual integrations. Working from vendor-agnostic principles, you turn standards and architectural direction into practical platform capabilities that perform reliably in production. You’re part of the PA Engineering Platforms Integration team and report to the Competence Manager.

Job responsibilities:

Build and maintain our self-service integration builder using reusable platform components, templates and shared services for APIs, integrations and event-driven solutions built on top of Azure Integration Services.
Develop CI/CD pipelines, automation services and utilities that support platform delivery and operations.
Embed security, logging, reliability, quality and compliance controls into pipelines and templates.
Translate architecture and technical standards into consistent, production-ready implementation patterns.
Onboard and support development teams using the platform, improving its capabilities based on their feedback.
Troubleshoot live integrations and take ownership of platform components in production.

Location

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken.

Your profile

You’re an experienced engineer with a strong software development foundation and exposure to platform engineering, DevOps and enterprise integration environments. Translating architectural direction and technical standards into reusable solutions comes naturally to you, and you enjoy creating capabilities that other development teams can adopt with confidence.

Your background also includes:

Hands-on production experience with Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management (APIM), and Service Bus or Event Grid.
Strong programming skills in C# or Python, combined with the ability to write and troubleshoot Bash and/or PowerShell scripts.
Experience with integration patterns, including APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture, and API gateways or enterprise integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD, deployment automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep or similar), and cloud-native environments.
Experience working with distributed systems and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Additionally, experience with front-end technologies such as React or Angular, as well as relational and NoSQL databases, is considered an advantage.

With a developer-first mindset, you balance high technical standards with pragmatic decisions that move work forward. You communicate complex topics clearly, collaborate constructively, and take ownership of what you build, while continuously improving the experience for teams using the platform.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Contact information

For further information about this position, please contact Mikael Berglund, hiring manager, mikael.b.berglund@sandvik.com

jobs.title: Snr GMP Software Developer
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for someone with a strong software engineering background who understands the full development lifecycle — from design and coding through testing, release, and operations — and who can translate that understanding into a DevOps strategy and CI/CD approach that integrates smoothly with how our development teams actually build software.
We are looking for a talented and driven DevOps Lead to define and own our DevOps strategy — the engineering practices, toolchain, and delivery infrastructure that determine how software is built, tested, and released across the organisation. A key initial focus for this role is our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) programme, where you will bridge development, operations, and quality in a regulated manufacturing environment, but the role's remit extends beyond any single platform. Prior exposure to MES platforms such as Syncade is a plus, but not a prerequisite.
Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that reflect a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring builds, tests, and deployments integrate smoothly with how engineering teams design, code, and release software — including for MES deployments across development, test, and production environments
Develop, own, and continuously evolve our DevOps strategy — defining the target toolchain, automation approach, and ways of working that align development and operations across the organisation, with the MES programme as an initial priority area.
Work with MES Vendors to define requirements and shape development to align to the DevOps strategy
.
Own the DevOps toolchain — source control, build automation, release management, environment provisioning, monitoring, and observability.
Define and enforce branching strategies, code review processes, and release management standards appropriate to a regulated manufacturing environment.
Work closely with vendors, system integrators, and internal teams to understand platform architecture and translate this into maintainable infrastructure-as-code and deployment automation.
Lead environment management across the software estate — including MES ensuring environments are correctly configured, version-controlled, and fit for purpose across all lifecycle stages.
Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to provide operational visibility of MES platform health and performance.
Drive shift-left quality practices — working with the testing team to embed automated testing into pipelines and ensuring quality gates are robust.
Support computer system validation (CSV) activities, maintaining audit trails, deployment records, and change control documentation in compliance with GxP requirements.
Manage infrastructure provisioning supporting workloads, ensuring security, resilience, and scalability.
Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the delivery pipeline, continuously improving deployment frequency, lead time, and recovery metrics (DORA).
Act as a technical authority and escalation point for infrastructure and deployment issues across the MES programme.

Essential Requirements

Software development background — hands-on experience as a software engineer or developer, with a solid grasp of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), coding practices, and application architecture, and the ability to use that experience to shape how DevOps and CI/CD integrate with development teams' ways of working.
Proven experience in a DevOps Lead or Senior DevOps Engineer role on complex enterprise software programmes.
Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling — Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent.
Solid understanding of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) and configuration management practices.
Experience managing environments for large-scale enterprise applications, including environment promotion strategies and configuration management.
Proficiency in scripting languages (PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar) for automation and tooling.
Demonstrated experience defining or evolving a DevOps strategy or roadmap — toolchain selection, automation approach, and ways of working — grounded in a strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, release management, and change control in enterprise settings.
Experience working in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, life sciences, or similar) with awareness of compliance and validation requirements.
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure and deployment issues under pressure.

Desirable Requirements

Direct experience deploying, maintaining, or supporting off-the-shelf MES platforms— including configuration, and upgrade activities.
Familiarity with GxP computer system validation (CSV), GAMP 5 lifecycle, and associated documentation requirements (IQ, OQ, PQ).
Knowledge of containerisation technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and their applicability within regulated manufacturing environments.
Understanding of MES integration patterns — ERP (SAP), LIMS, historian, and shop-floor device connectivity.
Experience with security hardening, vulnerability management, and operational security in manufacturing environments.

Show more

Show less

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Automation Machinery Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, and Medical Equipment Manufacturing

jobs.title: AI & Data - AI Lab: Full-Stack Engineer - Agentic AI Platform - Manager
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

General Information

Location:
Ireland - Dublin

Available for Work Visa Sponsorship:
No

Business Area:
AI & Data

EY exists to build a better working world, we empower our people by offering the culture, tech, teams, scale, challenges, learning, and the relationships for you to personalise and build your career, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

The Team and the opportunity

Join EY’s AI Lab, part of our innovation hub for EY Ireland .
The AI Lab is where cutting-edge ideas meet real-world impact. We focus on developing advanced AI solutions, experimenting with emerging technologies, and creating prototypes that push the boundaries of what’s possible.

As part of this team, you’ll:

Collaborate with experts in data science, machine learning, and engineering to design and deliver transformative AI solutions.
Work on pioneering projects that explore generative AI, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation.
Shape the future of business by turning research into scalable solutions for global clients.
Innovate in a dynamic environment, where creativity and experimentation are encouraged.

This is more than a role—it’s an opportunity to be part of a team that is redefining how organizations harness AI to solve complex challenges. If you’re passionate about innovation and want to work at the forefront of AI technology, the AI Lab is the place for you.

Your Key Responsibilities

Design, develop and maintain full-stack web applications supporting agentic AI workflows.
Build cloud-native microservices and APIs (FastAPI, Node.js, Python) integrating LLM and RAG components.
Develop responsive front-ends using React and Power Apps to provide intuitive user experiences.
Implement CI/CD pipelines, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and monitoring for performance and reliability.
Collaborate cross-functionally to integrate Azure OpenAI, LangChain/LangGraph, and Power Automate flows into the platform.
Contribute to engineering standards, code reviews and reusable AI Lab components.

To qualify for the role, you must have

5-7 + years’ experience delivering full-stack applications in production.
Proficiency in React (or Angular/Vue), Node.js and Python frameworks.
Experience building APIs (REST / GraphQL) and deploying on Azure or AWS using containerisation and serverless patterns.
Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases and data pipeline integration.
Understanding of LLM integration, prompt engineering, and AI API consumption.

Ideally, you will also have

Experience with LangChain/LangGraph, RAG pipelines and agentic architectures.
Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Apps / Power Automate) and workflow automation.
Strong DevOps skills and testing automation mindset

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include:

Pension
Discounted health insurance
Web Doctor - Free unlimited online GP consultations for you and your family
The purchase of additional annual leave
Hybrid Working
Free Gym membership
Travel Pass
Maternity & Paternity leave
Bike to work Scheme
Recognition Awards
Cash incentives for referrals
Work Mobile
TECH MBA paid by EY
Wellness rooms Available in some offices

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

Career Progression

When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one.
Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are - success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture, you will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
We have embraced Hybrid working at EY adding greater flexibility and autonomy to the roles of our employees.

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Inclusion & Diversity

We hold a collective commitment to foster an environment where all differences are valued and respected, practices are equitable and everyone experiences a sense of belonging: Inclusion, diversity, and equity are part of who we are at EY. We believe that the highest-performing teams maximize the power of different perspectives and backgrounds. These teams are both diverse and inclusive and are willing to invite and learn from other perspectives. Our ability to include various viewpoints into our mindsets, behaviours and operations is fundamental to driving innovation, building strong relationships, and delivering the best solutions for our clients.

We recognise the strength that comes from having a diverse workforce and building a culture where we support all our people to achieve their potential. You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

As an equal opportunities’ employer, we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are offered at every stage of our recruitment process.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

IMPORTANT: Where Agency assistance is required, our Talent Team will engage directly with suppliers. CVs / Profiles should not be shared directly with Hiring Managers. Unsolicited CVs / Profiles supplied to EY by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this role

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
